Smoke Flask

You seal the cloudy mixture quickly, before the first acrid curl reaches your eyes.

Rules

The useful bottle is the one you prepared before you needed it.

Recipe permission: @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.2321f6abd483bf9b.JournalEntryPage.a0575a82d5fd2963]{Smoke in a Bottle}. Tools: Mixing kit. Time: One hour per attempt. Materials: Dry puffleaf, prepared mineral dust and a stoppered bottle; one compatible material-bundle use per attempt if carried.

Roll the crafting card’s attribute. Weak/Standard/Strong raises one bundle by 1/2/3 inventory steps, from out to d4 first, maximum d6. Check material supply after the attempt. No group crafting. Ingredients must actually be acquired.

Smoke supply for Smoke in a Bottle; no damage or poison.

Each finished bundle/bottle is Bulk 1. Recipe knowledge creates no free stock. This is a ordinary recipe; the plants and salts are fictional ingredients, not real preparation instructions.
